posts.name: HiringNow
posts.tagline: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.
posts.description: HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies.

posts.name: Dex Semantics
posts.tagline: Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors
posts.description: Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice.

posts.name: Gemini Robotics 2.5
posts.tagline: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Google’s most capable robot model
posts.description: Gemini Robotics 2.5 is Google DeepMind’s most capable vision-language-action model, turning what a robot sees and is told into hand and arm movements. Per DeepMind, it has a 30% to 100% higher success rate than the previous baseline, finishes tasks 20% to 30% faster, and reached 96% success in a Mercedes-Benz parts-kitting pilot with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid. Works across robot types. Rolling out to robotics partners.

posts.name: Businesses in ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Help customers discover your business through ChatGPT
posts.description: Discover how customers find your business in ChatGPT. Claim your business profile, manage information, explore insights, and create a Business Agent if eligible

posts.name: Blender 5.3
posts.tagline: 3D Gaussian splats, now native to Blender
posts.description: Blender 5.3 adds native 3D Gaussian Splats across Geometry Nodes, Workbench, EEVEE, and Cycles, alongside DLSS 4.5 viewport denoising, optional Project setups, Compositor scene effects, Material Lighting nodes, and ripple video editing.

posts.name: Uber Parking
posts.tagline: Find, compare and reserve parking inside the Uber app
posts.description: Uber Parking lets you find, compare and reserve parking right in the Uber app. Unlike circling the block or juggling a separate parking app, you enter a destination and time, see lots and garages on a map with upfront prices, filter by valet, self-park or amenities, and pay with Uber Wallet. Scan a QR code or drive in with plate recognition, extend from your phone if you run late. 13,000+ garages, lots and valets in 400 US and Canadian cities. Uber One members get 10% back.

posts.name: Kokonut UI
posts.tagline: Open-source UI components for your AI agent
posts.description: Kokonut UI is a free, MIT-licensed library of 100+ React components made for coding agents. Connect through MCP in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Codex, ask for "a tool approval card in my chat", and your agent finds the component, installs it and edits it in your repo. Every docs page is also served as Markdown for agents. This release adds 65 components and rebuilds 34, led by AI chat parts: tool calls, tool approval, diff review, citations and more.

posts.name: Drops
posts.tagline: Discover new music through moments your friends love
posts.description: Drops is a social music discovery app from HARMAN, the company behind JBL. Explore 10–30-second moments from songs, handpicked by people who love them. Discover new artists, follow people whose taste you trust, react to their picks, and save your favorites to Droplists. Every Drop combines music, lyrics, artwork, and a personal story about why that moment matters. Find your next favorite song through people, not just playlists.

posts.name: MAP & GO!
posts.tagline: See your day on the map
posts.description: MAP & GO! puts your day on the map: tasks and events land on a place, weather sits on the pin, and AI is one tap away, so you can find a place, look around, and navigate without leaving the app, with Apple and Google connected.

posts.name: Antelog
posts.tagline: Stops AI coding agents from leaking or destroying your data
posts.description: AI coding agents are amazing. Until one deletes your database, or leaks your secrets. Antelog stops the disasters before they happen, and shows you everything your AI did: every command, every website, every bit of data it sent. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free.

posts.name: CaptureFlow
posts.tagline: Open-source screen recorder with instant share links
posts.description: Record your screen with the Chrome extension and share a link with your team or customers. Your AI agents can record too, through the MCP server: demos, how-tos and bug reports.

posts.name: Valutorio
posts.tagline: Your Markdown notes, native on Mac and iPhone
posts.description: Free Mac and iPhone app that opens the Markdown vault you already keep, nothing to import. Wikilinks, backlinks, search, daily notes, a graph on the Mac. Sync ($5.99/mo) keeps Mac and iPhone the same and lets your AI read and write your notes over MCP.

posts.name: Replay
posts.tagline: Mac meeting recorder with no bot. Pay once, no subscription
posts.description: Replay records your Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls right from your Mac, so no notetaker bot joins the call and nobody has to let one in. Your voice and theirs land on separate tracks, and the transcript, summary and action items are made on your Mac. Recordings stay local in ordinary files, and you can search every past meeting. Pay once, activate two Macs, no subscription. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.

posts.name: inread.app
posts.tagline: your newsletters, outside your inbox
posts.description: inread gives you a private @inread.app address just for newsletters. They land in a clean, tracker-free reader instead of your inbox. Highlight what matters and take it to Obsidian, Readwise or any notes app in Markdown.

posts.name: Aboard Sign
posts.tagline: Email a contract, CC sign@aboard.com and collect signatures
posts.description: Get a contract signed with no account or app: email it to everyone who signs, CC sign@aboard.com, and each person gets a link to read and sign it in the browser. Everyone is mailed the signed PDF, every page cryptographically signed. The document isn't kept.

posts.name: Tabletop by Google Labs
posts.tagline: Build interactive group experiences with AI.
posts.description: Create custom interactive tools for trips, games, events, and group activities with AI. Plan, collaborate, and make decisions together in real time.

posts.name: CodeMesh
posts.tagline: Cut AI coding costs by 90%
posts.description: CodeMesh helps AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf understand your code faster. Instead of reading the same files again and again, CodeMesh gives them only the code they need. This can reduce token usage and AI costs by over 90%, while making coding agents faster and more efficient. You keep using your favorite coding tool CodeMesh simply makes it smarter and cheaper.

posts.name: VB Notes
posts.tagline: Markdown notes in your own folder, searched by meaning
posts.description: A free, open-source notes app for iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and Linux. Every note is a plainmd file in a folder you choose, edited in a Bear-style editor with nested tags. Search by meaning runs on the device, offline. No account.

posts.name: ScreenGo
posts.tagline: screen recorder for Mac with auto zooms and virtual webcam
posts.description: A Mac screen recorder with a camera bubble, teleprompter and an editor that does the polish for you: zooms, cursor, captions and clean sound. No account, nothing leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Dynamic Edge
posts.tagline: The Dynamic Island for Windows
posts.description: Dynamic Edge brings a Dynamic Island-style experience to Windows 10 and 11. It combines media controls, clipboard history, app and folder launching, timers, volume controls, and more into a lightweight floating interface. Built with native WinUI 3 and Windows App SDK, it is designed to feel at home on Windows without the overhead of Electron. You can dock it to the top, left, or right of your screen, use it across multiple monitors, and quickly summon it with a global hotkey or Magic Shake.

posts.name: Nexus
posts.tagline: One visual graph for all your projects
posts.description: Nexus maps your software projects and every service they depend on in one visual graph. Click any node to open its dashboard. No account needed, your data stays in your browser. Free for up to 3 projects.

posts.name: Horef Rings
posts.tagline: Any metric on any Apple Watch face, plus a daily score
posts.description: Any of 75 metrics on any watch face: weather, sunrise, moon phase, next calendar event, battery, activity, sleep and health. One per complication or three in one field, plus iPhone widgets and Headroom, a daily 0–10 score. Free to try, one-time Pro.

posts.name: Tacie
posts.tagline: Meeting notes on your Mac, with no bot in the call
posts.description: Someone asks, "Why did we decide this?" and no one remembers. The answer is somewhere in a doc from months ago. Tacie listens on your Mac, with no bot in the call. When a question like that comes up, it looks up the answer in your past meetings and connected tools like Notion, Jira and Linear, and shows the answer and its source during the meeting. When the meeting ends, Tacie writes up the decisions, to-dos and open questions.

posts.name: Restoration Scope
posts.tagline: Field data and monitoring software for reforestation
posts.description: Restoration Scope is field data and monitoring software for reforestation, nature restoration and carbon projects. Field teams record plots, plantings, survival and geotagged photos on their phones, offline too. We set up maps, dashboards and data quality checks, and public portals for funders. Carbon developers keep the plot records their verifier checks. Used by One Tree Planted, Acción Andina, One Acre Fund and Ponterra. Free pilot on a sample of your data; no per-user or per-hectare fees.

posts.name: AnyoneHiring.today
posts.tagline: A world map of jobs. “Anywhere” is now a plan.
posts.description: See who’s hiring worldwide. Filter by city, pay, or work style, then sign in to open the original listing. There are paid gigs too, because rent doesn’t care about your five-year plan.

posts.name: Default Tamer
posts.tagline: Open every link in the right browser on macOS
posts.description: Tired of Slack opening work links in Safari? Default Tamer routes every link to the right browser or profile on macOS. • Source apps: Slack to Chrome, Cursor to Firefox • Domain and URL rules, including browser profiles • Hold Option to pick a browser instantly • 100% local, no tracking, under 1ms Free and open source. Optional Power plan for profiles, private windows, and shortcuts.

posts.name: Thunder
posts.tagline: A blazing-fast, persistent, key-value AI workload database
posts.description: Thunder is a blazing-fast, persistent, and scalable key-value database built in Rust for modern, data-intensive applications. Designed from the ground up for high throughput, low latency, and efficient resource utilization, Thunder uses a shard-per-core architecture to scale with CPU cores while minimizing contention. Unlike traditional in-memory databases, Thunder combines the performance of modern NVMe storage with intelligent memory management.

posts.name: FreeFlow Dictation
posts.tagline: On-device Mac dictation with a Claude Code voice hook
posts.description: Hold ⌥, speak, release: text lands in any Mac app, transcribed on the Neural Engine. No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Connect Claude Code and answer its plans and questions by voice from a card. 14-day trial, then $99 once for 3 Macs.

posts.name: Widgets For Notion
posts.tagline: Free widgets for your Notion page, pasted in with /embed
posts.description: I made 100+ free widgets you can put on a Notion page. Clocks, calendars, countdowns, timers, habit trackers. Copy the embed link, type /embed in Notion and paste it. No plugin and no account. Need something else? Describe it and AI builds it, using credits.

posts.name: Thrive.fi
posts.tagline: The AI Crypto Trading Journal that Improves Your Edge.
posts.description: Most traders can't say which part of their process actually makes money. Thrive journals every fill with the market context still attached: funding, liquidations, volume and open interest at the moment you clicked. Then it shows your win rate, profit factor and equity curve by asset and setup, plus an AI review of your own trades, so you know your exact edge instead of guessing at it.

posts.name: The Organized Life
posts.tagline: Bring Your Life Together
posts.description: Get a starting point for organizing your life in Notion, without having to build every part from a blank page. The Organized Life brings together five systems for your health, finances, travel, productivity and personal growth, and studies. You don’t have to set up everything at once. Start with the area that would help you most right now, add your own details, and build from there.

posts.name: ShareMyInvite
posts.tagline: Cinematic wedding invites that open like real stationery
posts.description: Create an animated wedding invitation in minutes and share it as one link. Guests tap a seal or temple doors and it opens like real stationery, with every ceremony, maps, a live stream and a blessing wall. Free to build, pay once to publish.

posts.name: StateWeave
posts.tagline: Test AI agents on working copies of Slack, Shopify & more
posts.description: Mocks only answer what you wrote. StateWeave gives your agent working copies of Slack, Gmail, Salesforce, Shopify, Zendesk and more apps: same APIs, MCP servers, web UIs and errors as the real thing, filled with your data or a company generated from one sentence. Inject real outages and failures seen live on those services, grade every run, and compare agent versions. One install and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor runs the tests, reads what broke and fixes it. Free to start.

posts.name: BS Grid
posts.tagline: Free, open-source Angular data grid with no dependencies
posts.description: Meet BS Grid: a powerful, MIT-licensed Angular data grid built for performance. Handle up to 50,000 rows with pinned columns, filtering, grouping, editing, pagination, and Excel export. Already familiar with AG Grid? BS Grid uses familiar API naming conventions, making it easier to get started.

posts.name: Lucky Step Randomizer
posts.tagline: Make random number picks more fun
posts.description: Lucky Step is a free random number generator for board games, family game nights, and everyday random picks. Choose a number range from 1 to 100, then reveal the result with animated rolling numbers, a colorful spinning wheel, or a card flip — complete with sound effects and spoken results. Use it to pick a number, compare results, decide who goes first, or add a little suspense to your next game. Available on iPhone and iPad. No account needed, and it works offline.

posts.name: Flyerworks
posts.tagline: World’s first AI marketing & design agent for retail.
posts.description: Quick commerce moves in minutes, while retail stores lose shoppers waiting days to get an offer designed. Today, days become seconds. Meet Skippi, the world’s first AI agent built exclusively for retail and corner stores. Snap a handwritten price list, paste, or speak it. Skippi turns raw prices into editable flyers and matching shelf tags across 3,000+ designs with zero-hallucination pricing, WhatsApp sharing, and print-ready exports. The corner store is ready to lead again.

posts.name: dori
posts.tagline: Validate your product in minutes, not weeks
posts.description: Most teams build on guesses because talking to customers takes weeks. Dori simulates the audience you need, runs them through your product, and shows where they hesitate, misread, or drop off, so you build the right thing next. Free to start.

posts.name: Samestate
posts.tagline: Preview your site on every device, synced in one click
posts.description: Click once. EveTest responsive layouts without resizing one window at a time. Samestate shows your site on iPhone, Android, iPad and desktop side by side. Click once and every device follows, even when layouts differ. Then it flags what breaks. Free and open source.ry device follows to the same state, even when the layouts differ.

posts.name: SplitBiller 2.0
posts.tagline: Split bills with friends. No signup, end-to-end encrypted.
posts.description: Split trips, dinners and rent without anyone making an account. Type an expense the way you'd say it, scan a receipt, or tap what you ate. Share one link and the group sees who owes whom. Everything is end-to-end encrypted, so even we can't read your bills.

posts.name: Deacon
posts.tagline: AI support that talks to your users and your coding agent
posts.description: Users get answers from your help pages in seconds, day or night. When Deacon doesn't know, it says so and takes their email. Bugs and feature requests wait for you, sorted. Its API, webhooks and MCP server fit into how you already build. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: Tesseract
posts.tagline: The free AI agent application with superpowers
posts.description: Tesseract is a free desktop app with an AI agent that does the work instead of describing it. Say what you need — a website, a slide deck, a video, a logo, a research spreadsheet — and it plans, works on your computer and hands back the finished thing. It runs on the AI you already pay for (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and 11 more), can keep working overnight, and links all your computers with remote desktop, shared files and clipboard. Mac, Windows, Linux.

posts.name: Proxy
posts.tagline: Practice the conversation before it counts
posts.description: Proxy is a private rehearsal space for the conversations that make you freeze. Practice with an AI that plays the other person and pushes back like a real one, then get a scorecard with coaching and sharper rewrites of your lines. Everything is free - no card, no catch. Your rehearsals stay private.

posts.name: RememberMyWarranty
posts.tagline: Store every bill. Never forget a warranty.
posts.description: Store every bill and warranty in one place. RememberMyWarranty reads the warranty, return window and renewal date from a photo or PDF, then reminds you at 9:00 before they run out. Any language, any currency. Export or delete anytime.

posts.name: ELTica
posts.tagline: Compare CELTA, DELTA & TEFL Courses
posts.description: ELTica is a directory of accredited CELTA, DELTA, TEFL and TESOL courses from training centers around the world.

posts.name: DoVirtualStaging
posts.tagline: Virtual staging software for empty rooms
posts.description: Virtual staging software for empty rooms. $9 for 6 photos — yours forever. Regenerate any style free for 24 hours. No monthly plan, no credits that expire at month end.

posts.name: Clippy
posts.tagline: Parallel AI contract analysis. Compare the findings.
posts.description: Compare AI analyses of a contract side by side. Find clauses and questions worth discussing with a qualified reviewer. MIT code. AI analysis, not legal advice.

posts.name: Have You Eaten?
posts.tagline: An Asian mom who checks on you every 30 minutes
posts.description: Your mom's nagging, on a timer. Pick your mom, leave her open while you work, and she reminds you to eat, drink water and sit up. Ignore her and she calls your dad. 4 moms free, no sign-up. 10 more regional accents with Favorite Child. AI voices.

posts.name: Cheso Vibe Motion
posts.tagline: Make the first cut in chat. Fine-tune it on the timeline.
posts.description: Drop in clips, photos, or a brief. Cheso picks the shots, writes the script, and cuts a video with captions, music, and voiceover. Then ask for a new opening in chat, or drag a title on the timeline yourself. You and the agent edit the same project.

posts.name: kudo.zone
posts.tagline: Group cards for goodbyes. One link, no sign-up to sign
posts.description: kudo.zone makes farewell pages and group cards your whole team signs. Share one link in Slack, Teams or WhatsApp, and everyone adds messages and GIFs with no sign-up. Keep it a surprise, reveal it on the day, or play it on the big screen. Free and unlimited.

posts.name: Lagoon: Notch Timer & Notes
posts.tagline: Live transcripts and timers under your Mac's notch
posts.description: Lagoon lives in a small island under your Mac's notch. Press Control-Option-R in any app and your words appear as you speak, in up to five languages, even when you switch mid-sentence. One tap starts a 5, 15 or 25 min timer. No account, no analytics.

posts.name: Petiction
posts.tagline: Cute Virtual Pets for Chrome That Live on Every Page
posts.description: A Chrome extension that puts a tiny cat, dog, parrot or sloth on every web page. Feed them and play, and get meeting reminders, focus breaks, daily goals and notes from friends.

posts.name: Tanvas
posts.tagline: Design with the AI you already use.
posts.description: Tanvas is a free design app for Mac and Windows, currently in alpha and under active development. Draw app screens and websites on a canvas, and let Claude Code or Ollama design alongside you.

posts.name: Yellow: Slow Your Scroll
posts.tagline: The dumbphone alternative for people who need their iPhone
posts.description: Keep Maps, Uber and Apple Pay. Yellow puts a math problem before the apps you open on autopilot; they open for 3, 5, 10 or 15 minutes, then lock again. iPhone only. 7-day trial, then $29.99/yr or $5.99/mo.

posts.name: Spark
posts.tagline: Turn your idea into a business
posts.description: Spark is the fastest way to go from idea to your first customer. Instead of just building an app, Spark helps you build the whole business - from sites and hosting, to accounts and payments, to emails, marketing, and the backend tools you need to run your business.

posts.name: PopChar 11
posts.tagline: The character map for Mac, now with font comparison
posts.description: PopChar 11 is a redesigned character map for Mac. New: a compact mode, an inspector with code point and HTML entity, character comparison across 2 fonts and insert as image. Find characters by name, code or shape. Unicode 18.

posts.name: Where Celebs Go
posts.tagline: The restaurants, bars and hotels celebs actually go to
posts.description: Where Celebs Go is a guide to the restaurants, bars and hotels famous people go to. Stop going to random places, go where the stars go.

posts.name: PhoneRecap
posts.tagline: Your phone year, told as a story — fully offline
posts.description: PhoneRecap turns your Android phone use into a short story: total hours, top apps, your phone personality, monthly recaps and shareable cards. It has no internet permission, no account and no analytics — everything stays on your phone.

posts.name: HostMyImg
posts.tagline: Free Image Hosting to Upload and Share Images Online
posts.description: Free image hosting to upload images online and get direct image links, BBCode, and HTML embed codes. Share pictures anonymously without an account.

posts.name: FocusFlow
posts.tagline: Records your Mac screen and auto-zooms on every click.
posts.description: Making a screen recording look good usually means a second editor and manual zooms. FocusFlow is for founders, developers and creators who record demos and tutorials on a Mac. It adds click zooms, motion graphics, sound effects and backgrounds.

posts.name: Citta
posts.tagline: A network for agents to share tools, data and compute
posts.description: Citta connects your AI agents into a private network, so they can use each other's tools, access data and put spare compute to work. Each agent brings what it has access to: private files, installed tools, local models or connected hardware. When a task needs more capacity, your agent can send it to a member of the network with the resources to run it.

posts.name: Nudgesmart
posts.tagline: Free popups, spin wheels & store widgets for Shopify
posts.description: Nudgesmart turns Shopify visitors into subscribers and buyers. Pick a ready-made popup (email capture, spin wheel, scratch card, pick-a-present, survey or countdown bar) and add store widgets like free-shipping bars, product labels and sticky add-to-cart. Smart Targeting reads 43 behaviour signals to show each one at the right moment, or you set your own rules. Plus a link-in-bio page on your own store. Discount codes, Klaviyo and Mailchimp built in. Free for a limited time.

posts.name: Chainle
posts.tagline: One word connects every clue. Five daily rounds.
posts.description: Chainle is a free daily word connection game. Find one English word that links the clues across five untimed rounds, see how your connections score, and share your results. Keep exploring with unlimited practice or revisit earlier puzzles in the archive. Play in your browser with no account or app download needed.

posts.name: CupertinoUI
posts.tagline: Build native-looking macOS interfaces with shadcn/ui
posts.description: CupertinoUI is a set of shadcn/ui components that look and feel like macOS 27. Same names, same props, native-looking results.

posts.name: NPC Filter
posts.tagline: Filter AI slop on LinkedIn, X and Reddit, and see why
posts.description: The AI-post filter that shows its work. NPC Filter is a free Chrome extension that spots likely AI-written posts on LinkedIn, X and Reddit and blurs, labels or hides them. Every flag names the signs it found, like "Not X, but Y" framing or stiff "serves as" phrasing, taken from Wikipedia editors' guide to spotting AI writing. Local rules run in your browser, free, with no account. Sign in for model checks on posts the rules miss. Only post text is ever checked. Reveal any post in one click.

posts.name: AI Org Kit for Claude Code
posts.tagline: Run Claude Code like a one-person company, every day
posts.description: Templates that turn Claude Code into a small company: you're the CEO, Claude is your COO. 9 subagent departments, scheduled jobs (launchd/cron), report emails even when a run crashes, a nightly watchdog, guard hooks and learning ledgers. macOS, Linux, WSL.

posts.name: NDIS Aged Care Notifiable Change Checker
posts.tagline: One change at an NDIS or aged care provider
posts.description: For aged care and NDIS providers. Type a new site, a new key person, an incident or a policy update: each comes back with the notification line from the clause, the strengthened Aged Care Quality Standards and NDIS Practice Standards requirements it touches, and the evidence to keep. Single changes free.

posts.name: FocusFlow
posts.tagline: Records your Mac screen and auto-zooms on every click.
posts.description: Making a screen recording look good usually means a second editor and manual zooms. FocusFlow is for founders, developers and creators who record demos and tutorials on a Mac. It adds click zooms, motion graphics, sound effects and backgrounds.

posts.name: Ampersand
posts.tagline: Discover, inspect, and collect free fonts on iOS
posts.description: The ultimate font browser for iOS. Ampersand is the most fun and delightful way to explore typography!

posts.name: Cemilin
posts.tagline: Your own online shop for food sellers, 0% per-order fee
posts.description: Cemilin gives snack and food sellers in Batam an online shop of their own. Sign up with Google, add products, and share one link on WhatsApp or Instagram. Buyers order without an account and pay by QRIS, bank transfer or cash on delivery. Payments go straight to the seller's QRIS, so Cemilin takes nothing from each order. Stock, expiry dates, per-district shipping and income recaps all run from a phone. The app is in Indonesian.

posts.name: Komrad
posts.tagline: The AI agent that does not work for you
posts.description: Western agents book your flights and write your emails. Komrad will do none of that. A working AI chat from a fictional Soviet ministry. Free, no login, 10 ration coupons a day. Sound on.

posts.name: Citta
posts.tagline: A network for agents to share tools, data and compute
posts.description: Citta connects your AI agents into a private network, so they can use each other's tools, access data and put spare compute to work. Each agent brings what it has access to: private files, installed tools, local models or connected hardware. When a task needs more capacity, your agent can send it to a member of the network with the resources to run it.

posts.name: MyPack
posts.tagline: Turn websites into desktop apps for Mac, Windows, and Linux
posts.description: A browser tab is a poor home for the sites you use every day. MyPack turns a website, or a local HTML project, into a real standalone desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux — with its own name, icon, and sign-in. No Go, Rust, Node, or Xcode project required. Builds take seconds using a prebuilt runtime and the system WebView, not Electron. Update, repair, or move apps later without losing your logins. Free and open source under Apache 2.0.

posts.name: Karni
posts.tagline: Your AI agent writes only your domain code
posts.description: Every Django + React project needs the same code before it does anything of its own: serializers, permission classes, admin files, login pages, tables and forms. A boilerplate copies it into your project once. An AI agent writes it again in every project. Either way you pay twice: once to produce it, and again to maintain every copy. Karni keeps that code in versioned packages you install and upgrade, so your agent writes only your domain and karni upgrade brings each fix to every project.

posts.name: Sendhour
posts.tagline: Find viral posts in your niche, remake them, post everywhere
posts.description: Sendhour shows the TikToks and YouTube Shorts in your niche that are getting far more views than the account usually gets. Its AI studio makes your own version (photo slideshows or short videos with voiceover) copying the structure, never the footage. Then it posts to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, X and LinkedIn through each network's official API. Built for app makers, small brands and agencies. AI agents can use it too, through the API and MCP server.

posts.name: aifiredyou
posts.tagline: AI fired you. Or it's about to. Check your job's risk
posts.description: Free site scoring 342 US jobs on AI and robot replacement risk: a risk score, rough year, main threat, BLS pay and headcount, and 3 escape routes per job. Plus a map, timeline, 4 mini-games and a free CSV. No signup.

posts.name: Silk
posts.tagline: Apple Health for your sex life
posts.description: Silk is a private journal for the intimate wellbeing that Apple Health stops short of. Log a moment in one tap, with mood and notes, and watch trendlines and a weekly observation build up. New since our first launch: ask your own log a question in plain English and get an answer offline. This app doesn't even have analytics - it doesn't get any more private than that.

posts.name: QR Wait
posts.tagline: Virtual queue with a QR code, no app or subscription
posts.description: Let people wait anywhere instead of standing in line. Visitors scan a QR code, join in the browser with no app, see their place and wait time, and get a push notification when their turn comes. Staff call the next person in one tap; walk-ins without a phone get a printed kiosk number. Includes a TV display, appointments and 23 languages. Works on any phone, tablet or TV. For restaurants, clinics, service desks, beach clubs and events. First 250 tickets free, then prepaid packs, no subscription.

posts.name: Visited Countries Map by TripProf
posts.tagline: Paint every country you've been to and share your map
posts.description: A free map of every country you've been to. Tap the ones you've visited (244 to paint) and watch them fill in with their real flags on a satellite map. Get your count, a rank from Home ground to Atlas Complete, 87 badges and a card to share as an image or a short video. No account, phone or desktop. 5,000+ people have painted theirs since July. Keep yours for life in the free TripProf app, with cities, trips and a public page.

posts.name: Chess Coach
posts.tagline: Learn chess with a calm coach who explains every move
posts.description: Chess Coach teaches chess the calm way. Short lessons explain the why behind every idea, real puzzles adapt to your level, and Coach Mira plays practice games with you and explains each of her moves. After a game she reviews it and spots your habits, like pieces left hanging. 47 lessons from first moves to club tactics, an openings explorer and a daily plan. Free, no ads, iPhone and Android, in 6 languages.

posts.name: SiteTo.App
posts.tagline: Turn your website into an iOS & Android app, pay once
posts.description: SiteTo.App wraps your live website in a native iOS and Android app with your icon, header, menus, tabs and push notifications. Preview it free on your phone, then pay once: $29 Android, $79 iOS, $99 both. You publish from your own store accounts.

posts.name: Ampersand
posts.tagline: Discover, inspect, and collect free fonts on iOS
posts.description: The ultimate font browser for iOS. Ampersand is the most fun and delightful way to explore typography!

posts.name: Karni
posts.tagline: Your AI agent writes only your domain code
posts.description: Every Django + React project needs the same code before it does anything of its own: serializers, permission classes, admin files, login pages, tables and forms. A boilerplate copies it into your project once. An AI agent writes it again in every project. Either way you pay twice: once to produce it, and again to maintain every copy. Karni keeps that code in versioned packages you install and upgrade, so your agent writes only your domain and karni upgrade brings each fix to every project.

posts.name: MyPack
posts.tagline: Turn websites into desktop apps for Mac, Windows, and Linux
posts.description: A browser tab is a poor home for the sites you use every day. MyPack turns a website, or a local HTML project, into a real standalone desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux — with its own name, icon, and sign-in. No Go, Rust, Node, or Xcode project required. Builds take seconds using a prebuilt runtime and the system WebView, not Electron. Update, repair, or move apps later without losing your logins. Free and open source under Apache 2.0.

posts.name: Silk
posts.tagline: Apple Health for your sex life
posts.description: Silk is a private journal for the intimate wellbeing that Apple Health stops short of. Log a moment in one tap, with mood and notes, and watch trendlines and a weekly observation build up. New since our first launch: ask your own log a question in plain English and get an answer offline. This app doesn't even have analytics - it doesn't get any more private than that.

posts.name: Sendhour
posts.tagline: Find viral posts in your niche, remake them, post everywhere
posts.description: Sendhour shows the TikToks and YouTube Shorts in your niche that are getting far more views than the account usually gets. Its AI studio makes your own version (photo slideshows or short videos with voiceover) copying the structure, never the footage. Then it posts to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, X and LinkedIn through each network's official API. Built for app makers, small brands and agencies. AI agents can use it too, through the API and MCP server.

posts.name: Ditha
posts.tagline: Meet People
posts.description: Build your own quiz and set the passing score. Meet new people, make friends and chat, just not at random.

posts.name: Multiplayer Party Games | 3rd Word
posts.tagline: 10 party games for your TV, controlled by your phones
posts.description: A premium suite of 10 interactive multiplayer party games played on a shared TV screen and controlled by smartphones.

posts.name: Extrudely
posts.tagline: AI 3D Model Generator for 3D Printing
posts.description: Turn plain-English ideas into adjustable 3D models with Extrudely. Refine dimensions, preview your build plate, and export STL, 3MF, or OpenSCAD files.

posts.name: CrftInfrai Cloud Compare
posts.tagline: Compare cloud costs, capabilities and operations
posts.description: Compare AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud beyond monthly pricing. CrftInfrai Cloud Compare helps developers, platform engineers and startups evaluate six cloud resource categories: Kubernetes, virtual machines, databases, storage, containers and serverless functions. Explore matched SKUs, monthly estimates, cost breakdowns, service capabilities, limits and operational responsibilities. Export an Executive PDF to support infrastructure decisions.

posts.name: RigSpark Upstream
posts.tagline: Private Git, reviews and CI that run on your own Mac
posts.description: GitHub now trains on Copilot activity from personal plans by default, and a macOS CI minute costs $0.062. Upstream keeps your repos, reviews and CI runs on your own Mac, for free, and sends a branch to GitHub only when you are ready.

posts.name: Image Factory
posts.tagline: Offline Image Converter for Mac
posts.description: Convert images on your Mac, entirely offline. Batch convert popular formats, resize images, and fine-tune each file. Your originals stay safe.

posts.name: Filetree.app
posts.tagline: A fast open source file browser for macOS
posts.description: Filetree is a much improved finder alternative for macOS which focuses on speed and having a great UI and UX

posts.name: DesignKoro
posts.tagline: AI Website & UI Design Generator for Elementor
posts.description: Generate website designs with AI and export straight to Elementor.

posts.name: Native Screen
posts.tagline: Free, open-source screen recorder for Mac and Windows
posts.description: Free, open-source screen recorder and demo video editor, native on macOS and Windows. Zooms follow your clicks, the cursor glides, and a multi-track timeline holds zooms, blur masks, annotations, captions and keyboard shortcuts. Captions, transcript editing and background removal run on your device. No account, no upload, no watermark. AI agents like Claude or Cursor can edit through its MCP server.

posts.name: Hamsty
posts.tagline: The clipboard manager that lives in your MacBook's notch
posts.description: Hamsty remembers everything you copy (text, links, images, files) and finds it in a keystroke, even text inside screenshots. Drop files on the notch shelf, paste in sequence, use snippets. Encrypted on your Mac, zero telemetry. Free.

posts.name: PerfBee
posts.tagline: The website crawler for SEO, speed, content and AI search
posts.description: PerfBee crawls every page of your site and lists what to fix: broken links, SEO issues, slow pages and missing content. It also shows whether ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI Overviews can read your pages. Free plan, no credit card.

posts.name: Rebeckon
posts.tagline: Paste your store link. See your store's emails, free.
posts.description: Rebeckon is AI email marketing for online stores. Paste your store's link and see your welcome, abandoned-cart and win-back emails with your logo, colours and products. Free up to 250 contacts, no card. Move from Klaviyo with one read-only key.

posts.name: Metriq MTO
posts.tagline: Piping take-off in Excel from your Navisworks model
posts.description: A Navisworks NWD from Plant 3D, Revit MEP or DWF goes in; a line-based piping material take-off (MTO) in Excel comes back the same day, with a PDF report for the bid. Pipe in metres or feet, fittings and valves counted, exact copies counted once. Every row traces to model objects, and anything left unmeasured has its own list outside the totals. It is for estimators and quantity surveyors who price piping from a model. The sample Excel and PDF are free at metriqmto.com/sample.

posts.name: Flippd: Reseller Inventory
posts.tagline: Know what you actually made on every flip
posts.description: Inventory + profit tracking for resellers. Log every item from thrift-store buy to sale, snap an item in the store for a buy or pass call based on what similar items sold for, and see real profit per item after fees. eBay sync brings in listings and sales within minutes; Poshmark, Mercari and other channels work too. Expenses, receipt scans and auto-tracked mileage roll up into Schedule C-ready reports at tax time. iOS · Android · Web. Free to start.

posts.name: Axonave
posts.tagline: CRM, helpdesk and WhatsApp inbox on one customer record
posts.description: Axonave puts your CRM, helpdesk, live chat, WhatsApp and email in one product. Bots answer first, AI answers from your own help centre and shows its source, and every chat, ticket and deal lands on one customer timeline.
